title: thelypteris reptans
intro: Thelypteris reptans, commonly known as the Indian fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris reptans include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antispasmodic and antipyretic effects, and display potential anticancer properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal value and make it a valuable resource for natural remedies.
